Check a metadata draft against its schema.

Panel: [Collection](/docs/reference/cli/panels/collection/).

## Usage

```text
huron validate [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                       | Description                                           |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron validate meta`](#huron-validate-meta) | Check the draft against the schema of the collection. |

## `huron validate meta`

Check the draft against the schema of the collection.

With no draft, check the published metadata.

```text
huron validate meta [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |
